SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.

3. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.
   D. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.

   C. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map
